sentence_stem: If I had listened to my doctor,
correct_completion: I would feel much better today.
full_sentence: If I had listened to my doctor, I would feel much better today.
acceptable_variants: I would be feeling much better today.

options.why_wrong: The stem describes an unreal past condition, so the result must be hypothetical; a plain present fact does not complete the mixed conditional.

options.text: I had felt much better today.
options.why_wrong: The past perfect in the result clause is ungrammatical here; the result needs 'would' with a base verb.

options.text: I would have felt better yesterday.
options.why_wrong: The reference to yesterday contradicts 'today'; a mixed conditional needs a present result.

options.text: I would feel much better today.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditional: past perfect condition with a present result using 'would' plus base verb
explanation: The if-clause refers to a past situation that did not happen, while the result describes how the speaker would feel now, so 'would' plus the base verb is used.
translation: If I had listened to my doctor, I would feel much better today.
